001package pkg_commands;
002
003import pkg_engine.GameEngine;
004
005import pkg_entities.Item;
006
007/**
008 * Implements the {@code take} command, buying or collecting an item from the current room.
009 *
010 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
011 * @version 2026.05.08
012 */
013public class TakeCommand extends Command {
014    /** Creates the command. */
015    public TakeCommand() {}
016
017    /**
018     * Moves the named item from the current room to the player's inventory when affordable.
019     *
020     * @param pGameEngine the game engine containing player and room state
021     * @return always {@code false}; this command does not end the game
022     */
023    public boolean execute(final GameEngine pGameEngine) {
024        if (!this.hasSecondWord()) {
025            pGameEngine.getGui().println("Take what?");
026            return false;
027    }
028        String vItemName = this.getSecondWord();
029        Item vItem = pGameEngine.getPlayer().getCurrentRoom().getItem(vItemName);
030
031        if (vItem == null) {
032            pGameEngine.getGui().println("I can't find any " + vItemName + "!");
033            return false;
034        }
035        if (pGameEngine.getPlayer().getMoney() >= vItem.getItemPrice()) {
036            pGameEngine.getPlayer().setMoney(pGameEngine.getPlayer().getMoney() - vItem.getItemPrice());
037            pGameEngine.getPlayer().getCurrentRoom().removeItem(vItemName);
038            pGameEngine.getPlayer().addItem(vItemName, vItem);
039            pGameEngine.getGui().println("Took " + vItemName + "!");
040            if (pGameEngine.getPlayer().getItem("map") != null) {
041                pGameEngine.getGui().showMap(pGameEngine.getPlayer().getCurrentRoom().getMapImageName());
042            }
043        } else {
044            pGameEngine.getGui().println(vItemName + " is too expensive for you right now!");
045        }
046        return false;
047    } // execute()
048}
